releases.summary: Milestone release focused on shared core models, standardized core responses, safer config persistence, and stronger isolated integration testing.

features.title: Shared core model layer
features.description: Added core/models to hold reusable identity, repository, and operational structs shared across config, identity, repo, and SSH modules

features.title: Standardized core result objects
features.description: Core identity, repo, and SSH operations now return structured result objects instead of mixed tuple-style responses

features.title: Safer config persistence
features.description: Config loads and saves now validate supported versions and references, normalize legacy values, and save atomically via temp-file replacement

features.title: Stronger isolated integration harness
features.description: Integration tests now run with isolated HOME and XDG config paths, explicit Git system-config isolation, clearer failure output, and optional temp-dir preservation

fixes.title: Config validation regressions caught earlier
fixes.description: Integration coverage now includes invalid config version handling, duplicate user rejection, workspace removal, and binding override/no-op paths

fixes.title: More consistent core APIs
fixes.description: Core consumers now work against predictable result shapes, reducing command-layer branching and special-case handling

releases.summary: Milestone release that finishes the core extraction and CLI integration work for config, SSH, identity, and repository flows.

features.title: Core config module
features.description: Moved config loading, persistence, migration, and active identity state into core/config as the shared config boundary

features.title: Core SSH module
features.description: Moved SSH key generation, SSH config management, agent helpers, and connectivity checks into core/ssh

features.title: Core identity module
features.description: Moved identity resolution and identity lifecycle operations into core/identity

features.title: Core repository module
features.description: Added core/repo for workspace registration, repository binding, remote URL conversion, clone auto-bind support, and repository owner resolution

fixes.title: Thinner CLI command layer
fixes.description: Commands now route their core behavior through extracted modules instead of duplicating repo, identity, and remote logic directly

fixes.title: Consistent repository safety decisions
fixes.description: Repository owner detection, remote conversion, and clone binding now use shared core logic across check, remote, clone, bind, and uninstall flows

releases.summary: Bugfix release focused on uninstall recovery, post-uninstall safety, and repeatable integration testing.

features.title: Docker-backed integration test harness
features.description: Added repeatable host and Docker integration tests covering setup, identity flows, remote fixes, safety checks, and uninstall cleanup

features.title: Real-account acceptance test harness
features.description: Added an opt-in real-account test flow that backs up and restores real bgit, SSH, and Git state while validating selected identities and repositories

fixes.title: Uninstall recovery for existing users
fixes.description: Uninstall now restores configured repo remotes first, removes managed SSH config, restores or clears bgit-managed hooks, and restores backed-up Git identity when available

fixes.title: Post-uninstall read-only safety
fixes.description: Read-only commands such as list, status, active, prompt, and doctor no longer recreate ~/.bgit or reinstall hooks after uninstall

fixes.title: Optional SSH key cleanup
fixes.description: Added bgit uninstall --remove-keys so SSH key deletion is explicit instead of implicit

releases.summary: Phase 3 usability and safety release focused on one-time setup and automatic push protection.

features.title: One-time setup command
features.description: Added bgit setup to initialize configuration, install global pre-push safety checks, and prepare defaults

features.title: Automatic push safety checks
features.description: Added bgit check and managed pre-push hook integration to validate identity and remote alignment

features.title: Shell prompt integration
features.description: Added prompt-friendly identity output for shell integrations

features.title: Clone auto-bind by default
features.description: Repositories cloned with bgit clone are automatically bound to the effective identity by default

fixes.title: Consistent first-run behavior
fixes.description: Commands now trigger setup flow automatically when bgit has not been initialized

fixes.title: Uninstall cleanup
fixes.description: Uninstall now clears managed global hooks path and removes managed SSH config entries

breaking_changes.title: Legacy command deprecations
breaking_changes.description: bgit init and bgit setup-ssh are deprecated in favor of bgit setup; bgit remote fix is now legacy/advanced guidance

releases.summary: Code cleanup and improved installation experience.

features.title: Dynamic version fetching
features.description: Install scripts now automatically fetch the latest version from GitHub

fixes.title: Standardized user prompts
fixes.description: All confirmation prompts now use consistent UI patterns

fixes.title: Code cleanup
fixes.description: Removed unnecessary comments and improved code readability

releases.summary: Phase 2 release with workspace support and diagnostics.

features.title: Workspace management
features.description: Create organized workspace folders with automatic identity binding

features.title: Repository binding
features.description: Bind individual repositories to specific identities

features.title: Identity status
features.description: Show current identity status and bindings

features.title: Diagnostics
features.description: Diagnose and auto-fix configuration issues

features.title: Active identity
features.description: Show current active identity

features.title: Identity resolution
features.description: Automatic identity resolution based on workspace > binding > global priority

releases.summary: Initial release with core identity management features.

features.title: Multi-user identity management
features.description: Add, list, use, and delete Git identities

features.title: SSH key management
features.description: Generate or import SSH keys for each identity

features.title: Git config handling
features.description: Automatic user.name and user.email configuration

features.title: Clone with identity
features.description: Clone repositories with the correct SSH configuration

features.title: Remote management
features.description: Fix and restore remote URLs for bgit compatibility

features.title: Configuration sync
features.description: Validate and sync bgit configuration

features.title: Safe uninstall
features.description: Safely uninstall bgit and restore all repositories

features.title: Cross-platform support
features.description: Works on Linux, macOS, and Windows
